src/core/secret-formula/news.js.org: In the news today, humans make an antimatter animal sacrifice to the antimatter god.
src/core/secret-formula/news.js.trans: 今日新闻：人类向反物质之神献祭反物质动物。

src/core/secret-formula/news.js.org: You made one antimatter! Whatever that means.

src/core/secret-formula/news.js.trans: 即使它是反物质，又有什么关系呢？

src/core/secret-formula/news.js.org: Scientists confirm that the colour of antimatter is Blurple.
src/core/secret-formula/news.js.trans: 科学家们证实了反物质是蓝紫色的。

src/core/secret-formula/news.js.org: How does NASA organise a party? They planet.

src/core/secret-formula/news.js.trans: 电子现在感受到了生活中的美好。

src/core/secret-formula/news.js.org: We're calling these happy electrons 'Positrons.' Wait, that's taken?
